jobs.description:
If you are currently employed at Smithfield, please log into Workday and submit your application through the Jobs Hub.

Have a seat at our table. When you join Smithfield, you become part of something special – a company that's sustainably feeding people around the world, producing good food the right way with respect for our people, animals, communities and planet. With opportunities across locations and functions, a culture grounded in our Core Four values - gratitude, communication, respect and accountability - and a strong commitment to learning, collaboration, and innovation, Smithfield offers challenging and rewarding careers where you can grow, contribute and make a real impact. Apply Now!

The Value You’ll Bring

The position summary states the general nature and purpose of the job. Overall accountabilities are defined in this section.

Are you a creative, self-driven engineering professional who thrives in fast-paced environments? Do you excel at turning bold ideas into reality and collaborating with key stakeholders to drive business growth? If so, Smithfield Foods, one of the top 25 consumer packaged goods companies in the nation, is looking for someone like you to join our Engineering team!

In this pivotal role, you’ll analyze data and craft strategic implementation plans to optimize production processes, identifying ways to boost efficiency and eliminate waste—directly impacting our bottom line. Your contributions will be instrumental in the manufacturing of Smithfield, Eckrich, Nathan’s Famous, and other iconic brands, helping us meet the ever-evolving needs of our customers and consumers.

As Director, Engineering, you will lead and direct engineering operations across a key functional area, ensuring the efficient use of engineering resources to achieve world-class performance in our plants. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to drive strategic initiatives, resolve complex challenges, and ensure top-tier execution in everything from maintenance to capital budget management.

Your leadership will be critical in building, developing, and managing a high-performing team capable of delivering operational excellence and executing strategies that elevate the business to new heights. If you’re ready to shape the future of manufacturing and be part of an innovative, growth-driven company, Smithfield Foods is the place for you!

What You’ll Do

The below statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. May perform other duties as assigned.

Engineering Leadership: You'll lead engineering teams in various Engineering disciplines across plants to ensure optimal performance. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Operations, HR, Safety, etc.) to achieve company goals. Oversee and manage Capital and Maintenance budgets and project planning. You'll also drive engineering performance to meet operational goals efficiently and cost-effectively.
Strategic Plan Development and Support: You'll create and implement short- and long-term operational plans to meet customer and quality standards. Identify and implement strategies to improve operational performance with internal and external resources. Provide clear direction on processes, schedules, and priorities for engineering teams. Develop and enforce best practices for engineering development. Ensure facilities comply with internal and external engineering standards and regulations.
Asset Utilization and Optimization: You’ll analyze asset age and utilization data and structure models on optimal replacement timing as well as methods to increase asset longevity.
Employee Development: Lead and motivate engineering teams to achieve business objectives and deliver solutions on time and on budget. Partner with HR to develop leadership programs, manage performance, and build a diverse, high-performing workforce. You'll make sure to foster a culture of workplace safety, open communication, empowerment, and recognition.
People Management: Drives a positive employee experience through leadership by way of employee development and coaching.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Prior experience in an engineer role required.
Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and SAP.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
High level of written and oral communication skills, organizational planning, teamwork, analytical reasoning, and adaptability.
Ability to communicate technical ideas to a non-technical audience effectively.
Strong interpersonal, technical and presentation skills
Ability to work well with others in fast paced, dynamic environment.
Respectful, approachable and team oriented while building strong working relationships and a positive work environment.

Other Skills That Make You Stand Out

jobs.description:
We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions.

At nVent, we are a leading provider of engineered control buildings and electrical equipment enclosures, supporting mission-critical applications across power utilities, data centers, and infrastructure markets. Our solutions are highly customized and often integrate sophisticated electrical systems including control panels, switchgear, and cabling.

As a project-driven, engineered-to-order (ETO) business, we deliver high-touch, tailored solutions to long-standing customers with demanding technical and schedule requirements. The business is scaling rapidly, including the integration of multiple sites across nVent Trachte and the Avail EPG acquisition.

To support this growth, we are evolving from a fragmented, site-based model toward a more unified and scalable engineering system—improving speed, quality, and repeatability while maintaining flexibility.

We are seeking a senior engineering leader to lead and transform engineering across the Engineered Building Solutions (EBS) business.

This role owns engineering across multiple sites and is accountable for both execution and transformation. The successful candidate will build a unified engineering operating model across people, process, product, and technology—enabling scale while maintaining strong customer responsiveness.

This Role Requires a Leader Who Can

Drive standardization without losing ETO flexibility
Build a high-performance, multi-site engineering organization
Improve engineering velocity, quality, and capacity
Operate effectively across a matrixed environment

The role demands equal strength in critical thinking and hands-on execution, with a strong bias for results.

What You Will Experience In This Position

Lead Engineering Transformation: Define and implement the strategy to evolve EBS engineering into a unified, scalable framework spanning multiple sites, balancing standardization with ETO responsiveness.
Standardize Engineering Processes: Establish consistent, end-to-end engineering processes from intake and quoting through development, release, and documentation, improving efficiency, accuracy, and consistency.
Develop a High-Performing Organization: Build a flexible, multi-site engineering organization with stronger resource sharing, clear roles, and robust leadership bench strength and succession planning.
Drive Modular Product Strategy: Transition the business toward modular, configurable platforms with standardized architectures and reusable design elements while maintaining customer-specific flexibility.
Enable Tools & Digital Capability: Rationalize engineering tools and drive adoption of digital and AI-enabled solutions to improve productivity, design reuse, and overall engineering efficiency.
Deliver Engineering Performance: Improve important measures including lead time, efficiency, first-pass yield, and overall build quality while supporting business growth and backlog execution.
Strengthen Multi-Functional Execution: Partner closely with program management, product management, operations, and commercial teams to ensure alignment and successful delivery of complex customer programs.
Drive Continuous Improvement: Apply Lean and structured problem-solving to engineering processes, increasing efficiency, scalability, and predictability across the organization.
Engage Customers & Support Growth: Represent engineering in key customer interactions, bids, and blocking issues, ensuring technical excellence and responsiveness support business wins.
Ensure Quality & Compliance: Maintain strong engineering rigor, ensuring all builds meet applicable codes, standards, and regulatory requirements across all sites.

You Have

Bachelor's degree in Engineering; a Master's degree or equivalent experience is preferred.
15+ years of engineering experience, with 8+ years in a leadership role.
Experience in engineered-to-order (ETO) or project-based businesses such as control buildings, modular structures, switchgear, panel shops, or similar.
Strong background in electro-mechanical, structural, and/or electrical systems.
Consistent track record in standardizing engineering processes and improving performance in complex, project-based environments.
Systems thinker who can integrate people, process, product, and technology into a cohesive operating model.
Proven track record to lead transformation in complex, fragmented environments.
Experience leading multi-site or matrixed engineering organizations.
Excellent leadership and social skills. Ability to influence key partners with a heavy emphasis on change leadership.
Ability to travel domestically 30%, and up to 50% the first year in role.

We Have

A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day
nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.
Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nvent.com.

Summary

The Assistant Director of Engineering supports the Director of Engineering in leading the daily operation and future direction of the Engineering Department for a 1,196-room, full-service convention hotel with approximately 200,000 sq. ft. of meeting space.
